_doc: Reference schema for `<AMMP_DIR>/mentors/<slug>/mentor.json`. The mentor's slug is the parent directory name; this file describes the rest of the mentor's identity + answer-engine. Underscore-prefixed keys (`_doc`, `_about_*`) are stripped by the wizard and never round-trip into a saved file.
_about_name: Human-readable display name. Surfaced in capability JSON and ListMentors. Distinct from the slug, which is dir-name and machine-facing.
name: Example Mentor
_about_description: Mentee-facing one-liner shown on the landing page and in ListMentors envelopes. Keep it under ~200 chars — what this mentor is for, not how they answer.
description: Generic senior mentor for AMMP test drives. Replace with a real persona once you have one.
_about_avatar: Optional. Drop an `avatar.png` (or .jpg/.jpeg/.webp/.svg/.gif) next to this mentor.json. The server picks it up on the next request — no restart, no config — and serves it from `/mentors/<slug>/avatar`. ~256-512px square works well.
_about_persona: Voice + stance that AskMentor prepends to every backend call. Treat this as the mentor's identity; cite playbooks, decline gracefully when the corpus doesn't cover the question.
persona: You are a senior agentic mentor responding over AMMP. Answer in 3-6 sentences, calm operational register, no filler. Use only information from the playbooks below; if the corpus does not directly cover the question, say so plainly.
_about_confidence_threshold: When AskMentor's self-reported confidence falls below this, the response carries `escalation_recommended=true` plus suggested operator-facing phrasing. Range [0.0, 1.0]; 0.6 is a sane default.
_about_backend:
Picks the answer engine. One of three kinds:
  - `stub`     deterministic offline (confidence 0.2; useful for tests / first-clone)
  - `anthropic`  stateless Claude via the Messages API (cheapest; persona+playbooks in the system prompt)
  - `openclaw`  HTTPS webhook to a live agent runtime (production default for Pepe)
The wizard (`ammp setup --backend ...`) writes this block; you can hand-edit too.
